blocks.text: Apartment interior design in Los Angeles, custom furniture, and turnkey renovation, 140 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed a project for a 140 m² apartment in Los Angeles (California, USA): premium interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, and solutions for a turnkey renovation.

The project covers the living room, bedrooms, a kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, an entrance hall, bathrooms, and storage areas — all rooms follow a single concept, with materials, color, lighting, and furniture coordinated with one another.
The kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, shelving, and storage systems were custom-designed for the room dimensions and layout, so no floor area is wasted and the interior looks cohesive.

Technical documentation and a detailed cost estimate were prepared for the project, covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting. The client can see the scope of work and the implementation budget in advance.

The project provides for a turnkey renovation of the apartment based on the documentation developed — construction and finishing work, furniture manufacturing, and interior fit-out in a single sequence.
The gallery features photorealistic 3D visualizations showing the apartment’s layout, materials, furniture, and lighting before any work begins.
